name: Pitui Juedui Jinzhi
source:
Protagonist "Kariya" transfers to Tokyo's Tsukiyo High School due to parents' job relocation. To fulfill childhood friend's desire to write romance novels, helps collect material at school. Gradually grows closer to "research subjects" through various interactions...

...However, shortly after starting a relationship, realizes fading affection for current partner while developing feelings for someone else. Will you stay loyal through the relationship's rocky phase, or succumb to temptation in this increasingly twisted love triangle?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角“雁夜”因父母工作调动而转学到东京月夜高中。为了满足儿时好友写言情小说的愿望，在学校帮忙收集素材。通过各种互动，逐渐与“研究对象”拉近……

…然而，在开始一段关系后不久，他意识到自己对当前伴侣的感情逐渐消失，同时对其他人产生了感情。你会在这段关系的艰难阶段保持忠诚，还是在这个日益扭曲的三角恋中屈服于诱惑？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161760/]Steam[/url]]
